content.title: Troubleshooting ChatGPT Error Messages | OpenAI Help Center
content.text: ChatGPT may occasionally encounter technical issues due to factors like network configuration, browser extensions, or transient server-side problems. This guide outlines common error messages and actionable steps to troubleshoot them."Something went wrong."This is a general error that may indicate a temporary server issue or a problem with your local setup.Refresh the page or start a new chatCheck status.openai.com for known outagesClear your browser cache and cookiesUse an incognito or private browsing windowDisable browser extensions, especially privacy or security toolsTurn off VPNs or secure DNS tools like Web ProtectSwitch to a different network if possible"A network error occurred.""An error occurred while connecting to the websocket."These errors suggest that your device is unable to establish a reliable connection to our servers.Disable VPNs or proxy connectionsTurn off Web Protect or other security filtersTry a different browser or incognito modeSwitch to a different network or device"We detect suspicious activity." / "Unusual Activity Detected"This message is shown when our systems detect traffic that may resemble automated or unusual behavior.Disable VPNs or proxies that might route your traffic through flagged IPsRestart your browser or deviceUse a private browsing window to start a fresh sessionEnsure you are not sharing your ChatGPT account with other people; change your password and ensure your email is secureIf you're not using bots or automation tools, contact us to report the issue"There was a problem preparing your chat."These usually occur when a browser extension or URL blocker interferes with loading the page.Disable extensions that block scripts or modify page contentTemporarily turn off any unfamiliar or unused browser extensionsOpen ChatGPT in an incognito window or a different browser"There was an error generating a response."A failed response when ChatGPT is unable to produce an answer.May be a one-time error, click "Regenerate" button. Restart your browser or deviceDisable VPNs or proxy connectionsTurn off Web Protect or other security filtersTry a different browser or incognito modeSwitch to a different network or deviceStuck on "Thinking…/Generating…/Working…" or endless spinner"ChatGPT is slow", lagging, freezing, or unresponsiveIf ChatGPT is taking a long time to respond, seems stuck, or becomes unresponsive, try these steps:Check status.openai.com for any ongoing incidentsStart a new chat if the conversation is long or has many turnsRefresh the page or restart the appDisable browser extensions, VPNs, proxies, or secure DNS toolsTry incognito/private browsing, a different browser, device, or networkClear browser cache and cookies if the issue continuesIf ChatGPT appears to hang indefinitely without completing the response, follow this sequence of troubleshooting steps:Wait 30–60 seconds to see if the response completesClick "Stop generating," then click "Regenerate" to retryStart a new chat and resend your promptHard refresh the page (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + R) or reload the desktop appSign out of ChatGPT and sign back inOpen ChatGPT in an incognito/private window with extensions disabledDisable VPNs, proxies, or secure DNS servicesTry a different browser or switch to another network or deviceCheck status.openai.com for any ongoing incidentsIf the issue persists across browsers, devices, and networks, collect a HAR file and browser console errors with timestamps, note the model used and the conversation URL or ID, then contact Support."Download failed" / "File Not Found"An error that occurs when attempting to download files / click on file links generated by ChatGPT.For CustomGPT, ensure that 'Code Interpreter" functionality is enabled and you updated the GPT after checking the appropriate boxEnsure that the file is recently generated, files generated by ChatGPT expire quicklyDisable VPNs or proxy connectionsEnsure the file downloaded is less than the file size limit of 512 MB"Blank screen, frozen page, or endless loading"If ChatGPT does not display any content, gets stuck loading, or becomes unresponsive without showing an explicit error message, try the steps below.Hard refresh the page (Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + R) or force reload the desktop appSign out of ChatGPT and sign back inClear site data or cookies for chat.openai.comDisable extensions or content blockers that may interfere with the pageOpen ChatGPT in an incognito/private window, a fresh browser profile, or a different browserTurn off VPNs, secure DNS, or other security filtersSwitch to a different network or deviceIf the issue persists, collect browser console logs and a HAR file with timestamps and contact support.Still need help?If these steps don’t resolve your issue, please reach out to our support team. Please make sure to record the HAR file of you replicating an error before contacting support using the instructions in the article linked above.
